items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Dick Gibson formed - ten of the guys were there, Bob Haggart Mank Lawson, Bob Wilber and some of the rest and they formed the World's Greatest Jazz Band.

ctx.x: time and I wasn't ready to stop. But later on I got an invitation to go out to Denver, Colorado to do the Gibson Jazz party. And this was the annual party that Dick has and he invites alot of musicians out there. I ran into musicians I hadn't seen for years because I hadn't been active.

And so I got a very good reception and it was during this time that Dick Gibson formed - ten of the guys were there, Bob Haggart Mank Lawson, Bob Wilber and some of the rest and they formed the World's Greatest Jazz Band. Well in 1968 Dick Gibson brought the boys to open at the River Boat in New York. I didn't go into the River Boat with the Worlds Greatest Jazz Band but toward the end of their engagement which must have been around the end of December, I happened to go down to the River Boat to catch the band…
